name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage precious metals developer advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta and Catamarca Provinces, Argentina. The project hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with approximately 248 Moz silver and 2.54 Moz gold in Measured and Indicated resources. The company has received approval under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) and Environmental Impact Assessment approval, and is progressing toward a construction decision.
